blocks.text: Delhi NCR SaaS Product Companies (100–1000 Employees)
Scope: Noida, Delhi/New Delhi, Gurugram. Filter: own SaaS/cloud software product; public evidence of 100–1000 employees (inclusive estimate, may describe global headcount). Report date: 2026-09-24.

Note: User requested 20. Per skill contract (max 10 qualified; never pad), only 8 met all three qualification tests from available public sources. Unqualified / below-range candidates listed separately with reasons, not counted.

Excluded from qualified list (transparent): TradeX (~68, below 100); StartupFlux (~20, below 100); Xumane (revenue $10M, ~20 team noted — below 100); Clinikally (count unverified); Vidooly / QueueBuster / NapTapGo (headcount not confirmed in 100-1000 band).
Caveat: Figures are public estimates; may reflect global, not NCR-only, headcount. No personal contact data collected.

Sources: [1] Tracxn — Human Logics; [2] Wellfound — SquadStack, Trackier, TestMu AI; [3] GetLatka — ZiffyHomes; [4] Seedtable — BUSINESSNEXT; [5] Tracxn / GetLatka / Wellfound search results (2026-09-24).
